title: Mitigating False Credit Propagation: Probabilistic Graphical Reward Aggregation for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.03361v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rubric-based rewards are increasingly used for open-ended language model post-training, but criterion-level scores are often aggregated as independent utilities. This flat scalarization ignores rubric-specified prerequisite and activation relations among criteria, allowing reward or penalty to be counted even when the condition that licenses it is absent. We call this structural reward-aggregation failure \textbf{False Credit Propagation} (FCP). To address this limitation, we propose \ourname (\textbf{G}raphical \textbf{E}vent \textbf{A}ggregation for \textbf{R}ubric rewards), a probabilistic graphical framework for dependency-aware rubric aggregation. \ourname models each criterion outcome as a latent Bernoulli event in a typed rubric graph, propagates soft suppression from unsupported parent events to their children, and aggregates the resulting event probabilities into a normalized expected signed utility. translated_title: 缓解虚假信用传播：基于概率图模型的评分奖励聚合用于规则化强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.03361v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：基于评分规则的奖励越来越多地用于开放式语言模型的后期训练，但标准级别的分数通常作为独立效用进行聚合。这种扁平化的标量化忽略了规则中指定的标准之间的先决条件和激活关系，导致即使许可该奖励或惩罚的条件不存在时，奖励或惩罚仍被计入。我们将这种结构性的奖励聚合失败称为“虚假信用传播”（FCP）。为解决此局限，我们提出名为“图形事件聚合用于规则奖励”的方法，这是一种用于依赖感知规则聚合的概率图框架。该方法将每个标准结果建模为类型化规则图中的潜在伯努利事件，从未支持父事件向其子事件传播软抑制，并将所得事件概率聚合为归一化的期望有符号效用。这实现了线性时间计算。
tldr: 本文提出一种概率图模型框架，通过建模规则间的依赖关系并抑制未满足条件的信用传播，解决了规则化强化学习中的虚假信用传播问题，实现线性时间聚合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a probabilistic graphical framework that models dependencies among rubric criteria and suppresses credit propagation from unmet conditions, addressing false credit propagation in rubric-based reinforcement learning with linear-time aggregation.
